verses.raw: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
verses.text: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

verses.raw: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop<sup foot_note=255322>1</sup> in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
verses.text: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].

verses.raw: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.<sup foot_note=255324>1</sup>
verses.text: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.
